title: WHO puts suspected Ebola deaths at 220, warns outbreak is outpacing reponse efforts
summary: The World Health Organization warned Monday that a fast-spreading Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo and neighbouring Uganda was outpacing response efforts, with at least 220 suspected deaths reported.
